capabilities: Scan images for QR codes and barcodes
Report each code's format and exact text
extras: The scan blocks Obsidian's UI while it runs (about half a second on a recent Mac for the test image). main.js is about 3 MB because it embeds the WebAssembly engine. The plugin source is MIT, but the embedded engine @qrcode-ai-com/qrcode-barcode-scanner-wasm 0.11.0 is AGPL-3.0-or-later with some Apache-2.0 parts. Decoded text is inserted inside code spans (or a fenced block for multi-line text) so links, embeds or HTML stay plain text. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF; a code whose bytes are not all text is marked incomplete.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to decode QR codes or barcodes from images stored in the vault.
summary: On-device scanner that reads QR codes and barcodes from vault images and inserts or copies their decoded text into a note.
